campaigns.rationale: English demand for the highest-ticket range ABK stocks, rebuilt around the five live VTEK SKUs. The old single generic PPF ad group is gone: with four distinct film grades deployed, each gets its own ad group so the ad matches the landing page spec for spec, and PRISM colour PPF gets its own because recolouring a car is a different purchase from protecting one. The theme stays isolated from the rest of the account because service intent is most poisonous here - someone searching window tinting in Qatar wants a workshop, and ABK is not one - so it keeps its own negative wall, product-qualifier-only keywords, and copy that says out loud that the customer's own fitter applies the film.

adGroups.themeNote: Flagship gloss PPF. Takes the unbranded high-intent film-purchase terms plus the VTEK/Vertek brand queries, because the flagship is the page a brand searcher should land on. Spec-led copy (8.5 mil, Polycarbonate TPU, 10-year manufacturer warranty) is the differentiator no installer-competitor can match on a search ad. Bare head terms stay unbid: intent lives in the modifier.

notes:
PRE-IMPORT CHECKLIST - ppf-tint (FULL REBUILD, not a patch)

1. WHY THIS FILE WAS REBUILT.
   The previous version targeted two SKUs - vertek-ppf-weather-armor and vertek-window-tints -
   and stated in its own notes that if the 5-SKU VTEK range were ever deployed the file must be
   rebuilt rather than patched. That has now happened. catalogue.json (generated from
   "git show HEAD:src/data/products.ts") shows the live PPF/tint range is exactly five products,
   all brand VTEK: weather-armor ULTIMATE, PRO, MATTE, PRISM and vtek-window-tints
   (Solar Armor, Iconic & Indulge series). The two old slugs are gone from the deployed data;
   their URLs 308-redirect. Nothing in this file points at them.

2. BRAND TOKEN IS NOW VTEK, NOT VERTEK.
   The deployed catalogue has ZERO products under brand "Vertek" - byBrand.Vertek is null and all
   five film SKUs sit under byBrand.VTEK. Every word of AD TEXT in this file says VTEK so the ad
   matches the landing page. "vertek ppf", "vertek weather armor", "vertek paint protection film",
   "vertek window tint", "vertek matte ppf", "vertek ppf distributor", "vertek distributor qatar"
   and the two Exact terms "vertek ppf qatar" / "vertek ppf doha" are retained on the KEYWORD side
   ONLY, to catch the searchers who met the old spelling while it was live and indexed. Review
   those in the search terms report after roughly 90 days and drop them once impressions dry up.

3. STRUCTURE CHANGE: ONE AD GROUP PER SKU.
   Old file: PPF (generic) / Brand / Tint / Wholesale = 4 groups per language.
   New file: ULTIMATE / PRO / MATTE / PRISM / Solar Armor tint / Trade = 6 groups per language.
   The separate brand ad group is deleted - brand queries (vtek ppf, weather armor ppf) now sit
   inside ULTIMATE, because the flagship is where a brand searcher should land. Cross-group
   negatives keep the four PPF groups from bidding against each other: ULTIMATE and PRO both
   negative "matte ppf" / "color ppf" / "colour ppf"; PRO also negatives "8.5 mil" and
   "polycarbonate" so it cannot steal a flagship query. Arabic mirrors this with مطفي and ملون.

4. PRISM IS A DIFFERENT BUYER, PRICED ACCORDINGLY.
   Colour PPF is bought by someone who wants to recolour a car and is otherwise shopping vinyl
   wrap or a respray - not by someone shopping paint protection. It carries the highest max CPC
   in the theme (QAR 5.50) because the basket is large and the volume is thin, and it bids the
   spec's named colours individually (Nardo grey, gloss piano black, pearl white, metallic blue,
   satin metals) because those queries are cheap and unambiguous. Respray, wrap-shop and
   touch-up-paint queries are hard negatives in both languages (صبغ سيارات, سمكرة, دهان سيارات).

5. EVERY CLAIM TRACES TO THE DEPLOYED specs STRING. NOTHING IS INVENTED.
   ULTIMATE: Advanced Polycarbonate TPU, 8.5 mil (215 um), ultra-gloss high depth, instant heat
   self-healing, hydrophobic top-coat, 10-year manufacturer warranty, resists extreme UV, desert
   sand, road salts and chemicals.
   PRO: high-grade aliphatic TPU, 7.5 mil (190 um), high optical clarity gloss, heat-activated
   self-healing nano-coat, 8-year warranty, balanced flexibility.
   MATTE: satin matte non-reflective, aliphatic matte TPU, 8 mil (200 um), self-healing satin
   top-coat and grime shield, 10-year warranty, low maintenance / easy wash.
   PRISM: polycaprolactone-based colour TPU, 8.5 mil (215 um), six named colours, high-stability
   extreme weather adhesive, 8-year warranty.
   Solar Armor: Iconic & Indulge series, up to 65% TSER, 90%+ IR rejection, 99% UV rejection,
   Qatar Traffic Law & MOI compliant grades, 10-year e-warranty.
   The micron figures are omitted from ad text only because "8.5 mil" reads better inside 30
   characters, not because they are unsupported.

6. TINT LEGALITY - THE ONE CLAIM WITH A HARD BOUNDARY. READ BEFORE EDITING TINT COPY.
   The live product page now states "Qatar Traffic Law & MOI Compliant Grades", so the ads may say
   compliant GRADES ARE AVAILABLE. They do, in exactly two English headlines ("MOI Compliant
   Grades", "Grades to Suit Qatar Law"), one English description ("MOI compliant grades available.
   Ask us which grade suits your car and glass") and the Arabic equivalents
   (درجات متوافقة مع أنظمة قطر / متوافقة مع تعليمات المرور).
   WHAT IS BANNED AND MUST STAY BANNED: no VLT percentage anywhere, and no wording that implies
   every grade is legal on every window. Qatar restricts front glass and bans reflective film; an
   ad implying blanket street-legality is both a Google policy risk and a real customer-harm risk.
   "vlt" is a BROAD negative in the EN tint group, and نسبة التظليل / تصريح / مخالفة / غرامة /
   قانون التظليل are negatives on both sides, so legality researchers never see these ads.
   The 65% TSER / 90%+ IR / 99% UV figures ARE used - they are heat and UV numbers, not darkness
   numbers, and they come verbatim from the deployed spec.

7. ARABIC NEGATIVE MATCH TYPES ARE LOAD-BEARING. DO NOT "TIDY" THEM TO PHRASE.
   The best Arabic tint keyword is رول تظليل سيارات (tint roll). A PHRASE negative on تظليل سيارات
   would block it, because the product query literally contains the service phrase. That is why
   تظليل سيارات, تظليل, مخفي and مخفي سيارات are EXACT negatives, with Phrase reserved for
   unambiguous service strings (تركيب تظليل, محل تظليل, تظليل متنقل). Identical logic in English:
   "tinting", "car tinting", "window tinting" are EXACT; "tinting service", "tinting shop",
   "tinting near me" are PHRASE. Carried over unchanged from the previous build.

8. WHY "service" AND "خدمة" ARE NOT BARE ACCOUNT NEGATIVES.
   The company is ABK Trading & Service (للتجارة والخدمات). A bare negative on either word would
   suppress the brand's own searches account-wide. The shared list uses phrase forms
   ("tinting service", "خدمة تظليل") instead. Same reasoning for "installer": it is never a bare
   negative, because "ppf supplier for installers" is a trade buyer and is bid as an EXACT
   positive in the trade group. Only "installation" and "installer near me" are blocked.

9. THE HEAD TERM IS STILL NOT BID. "paint protection film qatar", "ppf qatar", "window tint qatar"
   and "ceramic coating qatar" are absent from every keyword list on purpose. In Qatar those SERPs
   are owned by installers and the intent behind them is a workshop, not a purchase. Intent lives
   in the modifier - buy, supplier, roll, cut to size, wholesale - so the modifier is what is bid.
   Expect low volume and high relevance. Review search terms weekly for the first month and
   promote any product-intent variant that surfaces.

10. NOTHING HERE PROMISES A SERVICE. ABK SELLS PRODUCTS ONLY.
    Copy was written against the banned list: no "we install", "installation", "we fit",
    "book now", "appointment", "we apply", and no تركيب / خدمة التركيب / نركب / احجز موعد.
    Note the PRO spec string itself contains the word "installation" ("Smooth installation with
    balanced flexibility") - it is deliberately NOT quoted; the ad says "Smooth, Flexible Film"
    and "Balanced flexibility keeps it smooth to handle" instead. The honest position is stated
    outright in both languages: "We Supply, You Fit", "We Supply, We Don't Fit",
    نورد الفيلم وفنيك ينفذه and نورد ولا ننافس ورشتك - which doubles as the B2B wedge against
    installing rivals who compete with the very shops they sell to. "We supply the film only and
    do not tint cars" appears verbatim in an English tint description.

11. NO PRICE LANGUAGE, NO PHONE NUMBER IN AD TEXT. The site publishes no prices for these
    products, so nothing here anchors one - no "from QAR", no cheapest, no discount, no sale. The
    offer is a WhatsApp quote. The phone number is deliberately absent from every headline and
    description: Google disallows phone numbers in ad text. Add it as a CALL ASSET. Final URLs
    must stay on abktradingservice.com - a wa.me link cannot be a Final URL because the display
    domain has to match - and each product page already carries the WhatsApp button that is the
    actual conversion.

12. STALE URLS ELSEWHERE IN THIS BUILD - ACTION REQUIRED OUTSIDE THIS FILE.
    campaigns/b2b-wholesale.json still points two ad groups per language at
    /b2b/products/vertek-ppf-weather-armor and /b2b/products/vertek-window-tints. Those slugs no
    longer exist in products.ts. They redirect today, but a Final URL that 308s is a
    quality-score and disapproval risk, and the correct destinations now differ per grade.
    Repoint them (or send them to /b2b) before importing that file. Also de-conflict: if
    b2b-wholesale keeps trade film keywords, drop the trade ad group here, or the two campaigns
    will bid against each other on "ppf supplier qatar".

13. BID STRATEGY. "Maximize conversions" is stated for consistency with the rest of the account,
    but with zero conversion history it will overspend on a QAR 55/day budget. Recommendation:
    launch on Maximize Clicks using each ad group's maxCpcQAR as the CPC cap, define the WhatsApp
    click and the contact page as conversions, then switch to Maximize Conversions after roughly
    30 recorded conversions. Budget rose from 45 to 55 (EN) and 20 to 25 (AR) only because the
    group count went from 4 to 6; per-group spend is unchanged.

14. GEO NEGATIVES WOULD BLOCK A FUTURE GCC CAMPAIGN. The shared list includes dubai, riyadh,
    kuwait city, manama and muscat to stop Qatar-targeted spend leaking. If the owner confirms ABK
    fulfils cross-border wholesale and a GCC campaign is built from the trade ad groups, those
    five must be removed from the shared list first or that campaign will never serve.

15. SHOPPING IS NOT AVAILABLE IN QATAR. Merchant Center does not support Qatar, so there is no
    feed, no Shopping campaign and no feed-driven PMax for the B2C side. Search-only here is a
    constraint, not a preference.

16. AD SCHEDULE MATTERS MORE THAN USUAL. The conversion is a human WhatsApp reply. The store is
    shut 13:00-16:00 and all day Friday. The schedule pauses Friday entirely and brackets the two
    open windows with a 30-minute buffer. Widen it only if the owner actually answers WhatsApp
    outside store hours.

17. ARABIC WAS BUILT FOR RTL, NOT TRANSLATED. No Arabic headline opens with a Latin token or a
    digit, none ends in punctuation, no em-dash or pipe appears in Arabic ad text, all tashkeel is
    stripped (each shadda would burn one of 30 characters), digits are Western, and Latin brand
    tokens sit mid-string or terminal. Display paths are Latin only (ar-ppf, ar-tint,
    ar-wholesale). Still: paste every Arabic asset into Google's own ad preview before import - a
    monospace editor hides bidi reordering.

18. ONE SKU DELIBERATELY LEFT OUT: autotriz-ppf-gel (PPF and tint slip gel, 20 L / 4 L, 1:1
    dilution, made in Germany) sits in the ppf category with a live page and is a genuine
    installer-supply product. It is excluded here to avoid bidding against whichever campaign owns
    the Autotriz range. Whoever builds that theme should take it - "ppf slip solution", "tint
    application gel" and "autotriz ppf gel" are cheap, uncontested, and reach exactly the trade
    buyers this theme is also chasing.
